title: A shorter connection
description: Move one pin, watch its bounding box, and measure what changes. A small experiment in half-perimeter wirelength.
scope: Two point pins on a 0–10 board. HPWL estimates connection length; it is not an actual routed wire or a complete placement solver.

cues.title: Two pins. One connection.
cues.intent: Identify the fixed pin A and movable pin B before measuring their separation.

narration.en: Two connected pins give us a simple placement question: how far apart are they?
narration.zh: 两个相连的引脚，带来一个简单的布局问题：它们到底相隔多远？

captions.en: Two connected pins give us a simple placement question: how far apart are they?
captions.zh: 两个相连的引脚，带来一个简单的布局问题：它们到底相隔多远？

cues.title: Width plus height.
cues.intent: Read the bounding-box width and height: 6 + 5 = 11 units.

narration.en: We estimate their connection with a bounding box. Add its width and height: six plus five makes eleven.
narration.zh: 我们用包围盒估计连接长度。把宽和高相加：六加五，等于十一。

captions.en: We estimate their connection with a bounding box. Add its width and height: six plus five makes eleven.
captions.zh: 我们用包围盒估计连接长度。把宽和高相加：六加五，等于十一。

cues.title: Move it. Measure again.
cues.intent: Move B closer, then find another position with a length between 4 and 6.

narration.en: Move B closer. The estimate falls to five. Now try a different position with a length between four and six.
narration.zh: 把 B 移近，估计长度降到了五。现在请换一个位置，让长度保持在四到六之间。

captions.en: Move B closer. The estimate falls to five. Now try a different position with a length between four and six.
captions.zh: 把 B 移近，估计长度降到了五。现在请换一个位置，让长度保持在四到六之间。

exercises.prompt: Keep A fixed. Place B so the estimated length is between 4 and 6 units, including both endpoints.
